theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks leads cross-sectional momentum and passes the absolute-trend gate with high durability (0.74) and breadth (1.0), indicating broad internal participation. Crowding (z=1.36) is a sizing caution, not a fade, and the trend discipline remains the only validated edge. Overweight the theme while respecting a strict drawdown stop; crowding and unscheduled macro surprises keep conviction low.
theses.dissent: Crowding and elevated unscheduled macro surprises (AI/geopolitics) create sharp reversal risk; past edge is risk control, not positive return, and the rank-IC is near zero.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses absolute-trend eligibility (gate flips to ineligible) OR durability_bar drops below 0.5.

theses.dissent: Geopolitical shocks or a flight-to-safety could rapidly revive gold miners, overriding the technical trend; the gate can lag sudden reversals.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners regains eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to eligible) AND durability_bar exceeds 0.5 for two consecutive weeks.
